joint_policy: Use PAR6 axes and joint-origin orientations, including J6, and the user-corrected 177 mm forearm. Move the lower-arm mesh and wrist origin outward by 0.65 mm from the supplied export. Convert source joint bounds into the normalized coordinates.
dynamics_policy: Inherit PAR6 mass, local COM and central inertia in corresponding CAD link frames, separately for each format. These are user-authorized shared estimates for PAROL6, not a PAROL6 measurement.
tool_policy: Reuse all six PAR6 flange-relative tool/jaw profiles. PAROL6 uses a 50.5 mm J6-to-flange reference distance, matching PAR6 housing-to-tool spacing with the shorter wrist housing. The supplied L6 end-tool mesh is preserved as source only, not stacked with the selected tool.

wrist_housing_reference.method: Largest connected housing component, maximum local Y. Exclude internal motor/shaft components, which do not define the housing mounting face. Shift the complete flange subtree by the difference, -6.6 mm, to preserve PAR6 housing-to-tool spacing.

geometry.provenance: User correction: both forearms are 177 mm. Wrist flange reach is derived by matching PAR6 spacing against the included CAD housing surfaces; not an independent hardware measurement.

actuation_policy: User selected finite position control with torque limits. Retain PAR6 simulation estimates; open-loop hardware does not imply infinite stiffness.
